---
title: "Code inside a tabset becomes notebook code cells"
format:
  ipynb:
    execute:
      enabled: false
_quarto:
  tests:
    ipynb:
      ensureIpynbCellMatches:
        cellType: code
        matches:
          - 'print\("first tab"\)'
          - 'print\("second tab"\)'
          - 'print\("outside"\)'
        noMatches:
          - 'First'
---

```{python}
print("outside")
```

::: {.panel-tabset}
## First

```{python}
print("first tab")
```

## Second

```{python}
print("second tab")
```
:::
